items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: Then we sent and got Ori in California... He sent and got him and came to Chicago.

ctx.x: Yeah, old George Fields. He was dead, I think. Mm-hmm. Then we sent and got Ori in California. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
What did Ori play then? He played trombone.
Yeah. He sent and got him and came to Chicago.
